printer.title: Select your printer
printer.description: Select the E1 to connect. If connection fails, check internet access and that these are current Studio credentials.

files.title: Connect your private Activity Lab
files.description: Import your original Anker Make Studio (formerly EufyMake Studio) device_list.json, login_info.json and broker CA certificate. This private tool uses its own cloud connection. It records activity transitions locally; it does not control printing.

user.title: Set up Activity Lab
user.description: Use your existing EufyMake monitor connection details, or import Studio files. Records stay on your Home Assistant instance.

existing.title: Select your existing printer monitor
existing.description: Reuse the selected monitor's saved credentials locally. Activity Lab makes an independent cloud connection and does not alter the monitor.

error.invalid_files: The Studio files or CA certificate could not be read. Select the original files again. Supported regions in this preview: US, CA, MX, EU, GB, DE, FR.
error.invalid_auth: Eufy rejected the connection credentials or topic access. Sign in to Studio again and reimport its current files.
error.cannot_connect: Could not establish a verified connection to Eufy. Check internet access, region and Studio CA certificate.
error.wrong_printer: Select the same printer when refreshing this integration’s credentials.
